translated: Actually, I love traveling alone too.
The other day, I suddenly got two days off starting the next day, so I decided to go somewhere with nature.
I booked it immediately the day before, and this time I went to Kinugawa.
I'd been wanting to go to a river for a long time.
And I had a feeling I'd have a full view of the river from my room.
So the only difference was the river versus the ocean.
I wanted to be healed by the water, so I soaked in the hot springs, and I always decide to do a digital detox when I go to an inn.
I just stayed in the inn and read books the whole time. The view was so beautiful that I spent time on the balcony listening to the murmuring of the river.
Sometimes I just want to see or be near water. I love the ocean too.
I want to be near it too.
I go to Atami every now and then.
I go to Atami often too.
Now I really want to go to Hokkaido.
